description: Verify that DUT's ICMP Echo Reply carries an IPv4 header whose Total Length is at least 20 bytes — the minimum sized header per RFC 791 §3.1 (no options, no payload would still be 20 bytes)
approach:
[Objective]
The IPv4 header without options is exactly 20 bytes. Even an Echo Reply with zero data must therefore present Total Length ≥ 20 — anything smaller indicates a malformed emit path.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. Tester → DUT: ICMP Echo Request (target_ip=DUT IP)

2. Observation (3 s window):
   • DUT → Tester: Echo Reply carrying an IPv4 header
      - Total Length >= 20   ← key check

[Pass condition]
Reply emitted with Total Length ≥ 20.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_total_length — Reply emitted but Total Length was less than 20
• Fail_timeout — DUT did not emit a Reply within the window

verdicts.Pass: Reply Total Length ≥ 20 — minimum header size respected
verdicts.Fail_total_length: Reply Total Length below 20 — malformed IPv4 header
verdicts.Fail_timeout: DUT did not emit a Reply within the window
